title: UI Designer – 0–1 Years Experience
description:
**About Enterprise Bot**
------------------------

Enterprise Bot is the leading provider of GenAI, Conversational AI, and automation software, headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland. Our intelligent virtual assistants and automation tools help organizations improve efficiency, reduce costs, and deliver exceptional customer experiences across industries such as banking, insurance, and logistics. Our mission is to become the world’s #1 AI-driven automation software provider within the next five years.

We work with leading companies such as the SIX Group (Swiss Stock Exchange), SWICA, Generali, and others to enhance customer interactions and automate business processes using our cutting-edge Conversational AI technology.

Our global team includes more than 70 highly skilled professionals from diverse backgrounds.

We foster an open, progressive company culture with state-of-the-art technology and flat hierarchies. At Enterprise Bot, you’ll experience a unique blend of passion, purpose, challenge, and fun.

**What you will do**
--------------------

We’re looking for a UI Designer with 0–1 years of experience who is excited about building beautiful, intuitive digital products and wants to grow in a fast-moving AI startup.

You don’t need years of experience. We’re looking for someone with a great eye for design, strong fundamentals, curiosity, and the willingness to experiment.

At Enterprise Bot, you’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, and AI teams to turn ideas into polished product experiences — from early concepts and wireframes to high-fidelity designs and production-ready interfaces.

And yes — AI is a big part of how we work. We want someone who is excited to use AI tools to explore ideas, iterate faster, and find smarter ways of working.

### **What You'll Do**

* Design clean, modern, and engaging web and SaaS interfaces.
* Turn product ideas and requirements into intuitive UI designs.
* Create wireframes, user flows, mockups, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs.
* Work primarily in Figma and create reusable components.
* Help build and maintain our design system.
* Work closely with Product Managers and Developers to take designs from idea design production.
* Collaborate with developers to make sure the final product matches the design.
* Think about responsive design across different screen sizes.
* Participate in design reviews, brainstorming, and product discussions.
* Explore different design approaches and iterate quickly based on feedback.
* Keep up with modern UI/UX trends and emerging design patterns.

### **AI Is Part of the Job**

We’re an AI company, so we expect our designers to use AI, experiment with AI, and keep learning about AI.

You’ll be encouraged to use tools such as:

* ChatGPT / Claude / Gemini
* Figma AI
* AI-powered prototyping tools
* AI image and visual-generation tools
* AI-assisted research and ideation tools
* Other emerging AI tools that help you design faster and better

You don't need to know every AI tool today. What matters is that you're curious, comfortable experimenting, and excited to figure out how AI can improve your design workflow.

**What the role requires**
--------------------------

* 0–1 years of experience in UI/UX, product design, visual design, or a related field.
* Fresh graduates with strong portfolios are very welcome to apply.
* Good knowledge of Figma.
* Strong understanding of UI fundamentals — typography, colour, spacing, grids, hierarchy, and visual balance.
* A good eye for detail and visual consistency.
* Basic understanding of UX and user-centric design.
* Ability to take feedback and iterate quickly.
* Curiosity to learn new tools, technologies, and design trends.
* Interest in AI and AI-powered design workflows.
* Good communication and collaboration skills.

### **Bonus Points If You Have**

* Internship experience in UI/UX or Product Design.
* Experience designing SaaS or web applications.
* Experience with design systems and component libraries.
* Basic understanding of HTML/CSS.
* Experience using AI tools for design, prototyping, research, or ideation.
* Personal projects or side projects that demonstrate your creativity.

### **What Matters Most**

We're not looking for someone who simply knows how to use Figma.

We're looking for someone who can think, explore, experiment, and create.

If you have a strong portfolio, a good design eye, and you're excited about AI + Product Design, we'd love to hear from you.

Your portfolio matters more to us than the number of years on your CV.

**Your first months at Enterprise Bot**
---------------------------------------

You will have taken on core design tasks for our conversational AI platforms, shipped polished user interfaces for enterprise clients, and learned how GenAI technology integrates with popular software suites. Anyone who matches most of these requirements should still apply.

**Benefits**
------------

* Work at a growing AI startup building real enterprise products.
* Work closely with Product, Engineering, and AI teams.
* Get hands-on experience with AI-first product design.
* Experiment with new AI and design tools.
* Have real ownership from day one.
* Learn quickly in a fast-paced startup environment.
* Work on products used by customers across international markets.

If you're a designer who is just getting started and wants to build the future of AI products, this could be a great place to start.

An eBay subsidiary, TCGplayer is on a quest to be the most trusted trading card game (TCG) platform — connecting and empowering the hobby community. title: Delightree - Senior Design Engineer
description:
### **About the role**


This role splits roughly in half.


The first half is designing for franchise operations \- multi location brands, franchisee owners, and frontline staff each needing something different from the same product.


The second half is owning the layer between design and code. You'll own the design system \- the components, patterns, and code. You'll write frontend code yourself, and you'll define how design work becomes a shipped interface for everyone else on the team.


That second half is why this role exists. Our approach to product development is shifting. Instead of traditional mockup handoffs, product managers and designers directly build working prototypes directly in code, using AI workflows alongside our component library. Engineering builds on those prototypes rather than starting over. You own this system and ensure it's up to scale and quality.

### **What you'll do**

* Design and build UI in the same motion \- prototyping novel AI\-native interactions directly in code rather than in Figma\-then\-handoff, especially where no pattern library exists yet.
* Sit inside a pod (PM \+ eng lead \+ you) and take features from concept to shipped, rather than handing off a spec and waiting.
* Own the interaction and motion details \- loading/streaming states, transitions, micro\-interactions \- the polish that's nearly impossible to fully spec in a doc.
* Build and maintain shared UI components so the rest of the org can move fast without reinventing patterns feature by feature.
* Work directly in the production codebase.

### **What we're looking for**

* 4\+ years in product design, with depth in dense interfaces \- tables, forms, permissions, multi role flows.
* Real product/visual design judgment *and* the ability to ship real frontend code \- not a designer who dabbles in code or an engineer who cares about UI, but someone for whom design and implementation are the same skill.
* Hands\-on frontend engineering. A portfolio \+ GitHub showing shipped, interactive, polished products \- not just mockups or case studies.
* Design systems built and maintained at scale, in code. You should be able to direct AI tools to build and maintain prototypes that adhere to accessibility, component system, and other guardrails.
* Experience or strong interest in AI\-native interfaces: streaming output, agentic/human\-in\-the\-loop UX, confidence and uncertainty in UI.
* Bonus: has worked somewhere small enough that design and engineering weren't separate functions. AI used structurally in how features got shipped, from ideation through implementation and review \- not just for copy or asset generation.
